remarks: Every detail has been reimagined in this top floor 2BR, 2 full bath condo, offering sleek, fully renovated single level living in a quiet 16-unit community in the charming Wolfpit neighborhood. The spacious skylit living room boasts vaulted ceilings, a wood-burning fireplace, and a slider to a private deck with peaceful wooded views. The open concept dining area flows seamlessly into the remodeled kitchen, featuring custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and modern appliances. The serene primary suite offers double closets, a ceiling fan, and a beautifully remodeled en-suite bath with glass shower doors. A second generously sized bedroom has a large closet and easy access to the renovated hall bath. Side-by-side laundry is tucked conveniently in a hall closet along with extra storage. Thoughtful upgrades throughout include gleaming hardwood floors, recessed lighting, fresh paint, upgraded attic insulation for added efficiency, newer water heater, and a well-maintained HVAC system serviced twice yearly. Full improvements list in supplements. A detached garage with large storage room, plus ample guest parking, adds convenience and flexibility. Move-in ready, this home offers the comfort of single family living with the ease of a condo, minutes to Westport, shopping, train stations, and major highways.
